failure_reason: Training CE loss bypasses SNN: pc_loss() computes CE on raw linear activations (h=x_flat→layers[:-1]) but forward() evaluates on SNN spike-count representations. SNN weights never jointly optimized with cls_head. Energy explosion at epoch 6 (train_energy ~22-31) across all seeds triggers early-stop.
notes: COMPLETE FAILURE: ~11% val_acc (random) across all 5 seeds. Train/val distribution mismatch: CE gradient path in training uses raw x_flat→layers[:-1] (no SNN), validation uses SNN spike-counts→PC inference→cls_head. Root cause identical to PC-EncDec v1 (anp_pcnn iter 6). Fix: compute CE on reps_init[-2] from _bottom_up(); make forward() pure-feedforward SNN (no PC inference).
